critique.evidence: The unknowns section has a cohesive, polished dark-grid aesthetic, strong headline hierarchy, restrained cyan/red/yellow accents, and a well-composed risk card that adapts cleanly across desktop, tablet, and mobile. It falls short of demo-ready polish because the global header visibly truncates navigation at tablet and mobile widths without a clear scroll or overflow affordance; the mobile header loses the product name and ends on a clipped item. Several mono labels and footer/source lines are extremely small and faint, and color-contrast verification remains incomplete for 14–26 header nodes. Desktop also leaves a notably empty right half above the card.
critique.fix: Redesign the tablet/mobile header as an intentional responsive pattern—compact menu, snap-scrolling rail with edge fade, or selected-section control—without visibly clipped labels. Preserve a compact brand identifier on mobile, raise contrast and size for microcopy, verify header contrast against the actual gradient, and tighten the desktop hero’s unused right-side space.
